name: DominoRole – User Role Permission Manager
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoRole is a lightweight and straightforward plugin designed to help you manage user roles and permissions in WordPress. It allows you to view all existing roles and their capabilities, as well as create new custom roles with basic read permissions.

Built with simplicity and security in mind, this plugin provides the essential features you need without overwhelming you with complex settings. It is designed for site administrators looking for an easy-to-use role manager.

Features

  • View a comprehensive list of all user roles in your WordPress installation.
  • See the exact number of capabilities assigned to each role.
  • Safely add new custom roles with default read permissions.
  • Delete custom roles (default WordPress roles are protected).
  • Lightweight, fast, and secure.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dominorole-user-role-permission-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools -> DominoRole in the WordPress admin menu to access the role manager.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new role?

Go to Tools -> DominoRole and use the “Add New Role” form. Provide a unique lowercase Role ID and a Display Name.

Can I delete default WordPress roles?

No, for security and stability reasons, the plugin prevents the deletion of default WordPress roles (Administrator, Editor, Author, Contributor, Subscriber).
